items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: Milt Buckner, Bobby Plater Britt not even

ctx.x: And I said, "How much money you pay you?" He said, "How much what you want?" I said, I want $400 a week." And he says, "That's fine, I'll pay you that." This is in California where he was playing a theater there. So I joined the band. I worked locally, like San Francisco and places like that, he paid me this money. Okay, Here we go to Chicago, I get called to the office and Gladys Hampton said, "There's some mistake in your payroll." Lionel ?s She said, That's his wife, Gladys Hampton is his wife. Say, "How much…

She said, "We don't pay anybody that kind of money, Milt Buckner, Bobby Plater Britt not even (unintelligible) the first alto player, Woodman, none of the guys get that kind of money.. Said, "there's some mistake, Lionel must have misunderstood you." Said, "We've got to take all that money back, he overpaid you." I'm in Chicago, you know?

So it's not too easy to quit. So she she said, "The most I can pay you is $125 a week. I said, $125 on the road? You must be crazy." So I started really putting a show on the band, get drunk, fight with everybody. Those two people are the most
